modern: What does no harm to the state does no harm to the citizen. Whenever there seems to be harm, apply this rule: if the state is not harmed by this, neither am I harmed. But if the state is harmed, you must not be angry with the one who harms the state. Show him where his error is.
original: That which does no harm to the state, does no harm to the citizen. In the case of every appearance of harm apply this rule: if the state is not harmed by this, neither am I harmed. But if the state is harmed, thou must not be angry with him who does harm to the state. Show him where his error is.
